book.name: HECHOS
book.title: JA' SK'ANEAL TZETTAJ YETAL JIX EL YUNEN EB ẌEJAB JESÚS

content: Ja' Sk'aneal Naj Pedro Yetoj Naj Cornelio
Ey jun winaj bey conob Cesarea chi yij Cornelio. Ja' jun winaj tu', yaawil jun bulan eb soldado chi yij “A Italia.”
Caw ey oc sc'ul jun winaj tu' yin Dios. Ey xiw c'ulal tet Dios, yetoj masanil sfamilia. Miman tzet chi el sa'on tet eb meba' xol eb Israel. Caw chi yi' atej sc'ul xali tet Dios.

Ja' yet junel, jaxca weyiche jix yute yilon jun yángel Dios yet mi a las tres de la tarde. Jix jul ec' jun ángel bey jun cuarto tu', catu' jix yalon tet naj jaxca ti': —Cornelio, ẍi jun ángel tet naj.

Jix oc t'anan naj Cornelio tu' yin, caw jix xiw a naj yu. —¿Tzet ja chi, Mamin? ẍi naj tet. Jix yalon tet jaxca ti': —Jix yab Dios ja txa. Jix yil pax ja sa'beal tet eb meba'. Ja' wan ti', ma to q'uey c'ulal yu Dios tu'.
Ja' tinani' xin, chejtoj jaywanoj winaj bey Jope, catu' chi to yi'on naj Simón eb, naj chi yij Pedro.

Ja' tu' ey ec' naj bey sna naj chi ijon pax Simón, ja' naj wa'nem tz'um. Ja' sna naj tu', ja' tu' ey bey sti' ja' mar. Ja' naj Pedro tu' oj jul alon e ach tzet yetal sowalil cha wune, ẍi jun ángel tu' tet naj Cornelio.
Ja' yet jix to jun ángel tu' xin, jix yawtentej cawan eb smoso, yetoj jun soldado yak'omal servil. Ja' jun soldado tu', asan yin Dios ey oc sna'bal.
Masanil c'al tzet jix al-le tet yu jun ángel tu', jix yal tet eb. Catu' jix chejletoj eb yu bey conob Jope.
Yewial tu' xin, yet chuman xa c'u, lalan xa yapni eb scawilal bey Jope tu', catu' jix atoj naj Pedro txaloj yiban spananil ẍumuc
sna naj Simón tu'.
Ja' yet ey atoj naj titu', catu' jix tit swail. Pero yajban chi wa'xi slo'be, ey tzet jix ak'le yil jaxca junoj weyiche.

Jix yil jaxca tol jix jajcha spuertail satcan. Ey jun tzet yetal jaxca junoj miman sábana jix jul eytej t'unun oj jix yil naj. Ey c'al oc spixil scanebal xiquin, catu' jix eyol bey spananil ẍumuc na tu', bey ey atoj naj Pedro tu'.
Ja' yul jun jaxca sábana tu', ey oc smasanil stujanil no' nok'. No' caneb yajan, no' laba, c'al no' chi ec' jenenoj yetoj xic'.
Ja' yet jix eyol t'unun oj xin, jix yaben Pedro tu' junoj jix k'anab yetoj: —Pedro, aan linan oj, mak' cam wan no' ti', catu' cha chi'oni, ẍi.
Jix yalon Pedro tu' jaxca ti': —C'amaj Mamin, yutol c'am to junel oj chin lo' ma chin chi' junoj awas ẍi'lei, c'al junoj tzet yetal c'am chi ske' slo'lei yu sley Moisés, ẍi naj Pedro.
Yuxan jix yal junel xa jaxca ti': —Ja' tzet chi yal Dios tol c'am sleyal, manchej ja wak' sleyal jaachti', ẍi.
Oxel jix yab naj Pedro jun ti', catu' jix i'le pax a jun jaxca sábana tu' satcan.
Lalan to sna'on Pedro tzet yel oc apnoj wan jix yil tu', catu' jix apni eb ẍejab Cornelio sti' na. Lalan sk'anlen eb sna naj Simón yet chi tit c'al eb yul-laj be.
Jix apni eb xin, catu' jix sk'anlen eb jaxca ti': —¿Jam titi' ey ec' naj Simón, naj chi yij pax Pedro? ẍi eb.
Ja'c'ala' to c'al jix sna'otanen Pedro tzet ye wan jix ak'le yil tu', jix yalon Santo Espíritu tet jaxca ti': —Ey oxwan winaj chach k'anlen ec' oj.
Aan linan oj, catu' chach eytoj. Asi' yetoj eb. A oc yin ja c'ul ja to yetoj eb, yutol jain jix jin chejtej eb an, ẍi tet naj Pedro.

Yuxan jix eytej naj, catu' jix eyol bey ey ec' eb ẍejab Cornelio tu'. Catu' jix yalon naj tet eb jaxca ti': —Jain ton chin ja k'anle ec' oj. ¿Tzet ẍi je chejbanil e in an, yuxan chex juli? ẍi naj tet eb.

Jix yalon eb jaxca ti': —Ey jun naj yaawil eb soldado chi yij Cornelio. Caw watx' sbeybal naj. Chi xiw naj tet Dios. Watx' naj yul sat masanil eb Israel. Ey scam c'ulal eb yin. Ey jun yángel Dios jix alon tet naj, tol chi ẍejtej ẍejab naj, tol chach jultoj, catu' chach to bey sna, yet watx' chi yab can oc tzet oj ja wal tet, ẍi eb tet Pedro tu'.
Jix i'le octoj eb yul na yu naj Pedro tu'. Ja' tu' jix wey eb, ja' yet jun xa c'ual, jix to yetoj eb. Jix to pax jaywan creyente a Jope yetoj eb.
Yewial to tu', jix apni eb bey conob Cesarea. Echbanebil yapni eb yu Cornelio tu'. Yaman xa ec' jantaj yican, c'al jantaj eb yamigo.
Ja' yet jix apni Pedro titu', jix eltej naj Cornelio tu' ẍa'oni, catu' jix ey kaan sattaj naj. Jix yi'on ey sba tet Pedro tu'.
Pero jix q'uetzle a linan naj, jix yalon Pedro tet jaxca ti': —Aan linan oj, yutol ket animail cu ba, ẍi Pedro tet naj.
Jix k'anab eb, catu' jix octoj eb yul na. Jix yilon Pedro tol ec'al eb yaman xa ec' oj.

Catu' jix yalon tet eb jaxca ti': —Je yotaj, jaon Israel jon ti', c'am sleyal chi cu junbane cu ba yetoj junoj tx'oj conobal. C'am sleyal chi cu oc yul sna. Pero jix yak' Dios wotajne el an, tol c'am chi ske' walon an, ta ey junoj mac c'am sleyal chin yamba jin ba yetoj an.
Yuxan, c'am tzet jix wal an, yet jix jin bet je yak'on tit oj. Ja' tinani' xin, chi woche chi wab an, ¿tzet yuxan jix jin bet je yak' tit an? ẍi naj tet eb.
Jix yalon naj Cornelio tu' tet Pedro jaxca ti': —Jam jaxca hora ti' oxi, lalan jin txali yul jin na ti' an, catu' ey jun mac jix x'ox a sba e in an, caw chi tzejeji spichil.
Jix yal jaxca ti' e in an: “Cornelio, jix yab Dios ja txa, catu' jix na'ontej wan ja sa'beal cha wak' tet eb meba'.

Ja' tinani' xin, chejtoj jaywanoj winaj bey conob Jope, catu' chi to yi'on naj Simón, naj chi ijon Pedro. Ja' tu' ey ec' naj bey sna naj chi ijon pax Simón, naj wa'nem tz'um. Ja' sna naj tu' ja' tu' ey bey sti' ja' mar. [Ja' naj Pedro tu', ey tzet oj jul yal e ach,]” ẍi e in an.

Catu' jix jin chejontoj eb jin chejab tu', jaach to seyon ec' oj. Yu wal dios e ach, jix jaach tita. Ja' tinani', ey jon ec' cu masanil sattaj cu Mam Dios. Yuxan chi koche cha wal e on masanil tzet albil can e ach yu naj Kaawil, ẍi naj tet Pedro.
Cuybanile Jix Yak' Pedro Bey Sna Naj Cornelio
Catu' jix ẍa'on el yich sk'anab naj Pedro snan xol eb jaxca ti': —Ja' tinani', wotaj an, tol caw yel laan c'al yel oc apnoj masanil ánima yul sat Dios.
Yal c'al mac ey Dios yul sat, cax c'al man Israel oj, caw chi tzala yetoj eb, ta watx' tzet chi yune'.
Ja' Dios jix ak'on can sk'ane e on, jaon Israel jon ti'. Yalnaj can e on chi xa ske' tol ey watx' c'ulal snan cu xol yetoj Dios yu Jesucristo, naj Kaawil cu masanil.
Jaexti', je yotaj xa tzet jix el yunen Dios bey cu lugar, jaon Israel jon ti'. Ja' bey Galilea elnaj can yich, yet jix lawi yalon el sk'ane Dios naj Juan c'al yet jix lawi yak'wi bautizar ánima naj.

Je yotaj, tzet utbil tol ja' Dios, yak'naj Santo Espíritu tet Jesús a Nazaret. Catu' yak'naj pax yipal tet. Je yotaj pax oj, tol jix colwa naj Jesús yin eb ánima. Masanil c'al mac etexnaj yu diablo, jix ak'le can wa'xoj sc'ul eb. Jix ske' yunen masanil wan tu', yutol ey oc Dios yetoj.

Jaonti', chi kak' cu ba testigoal yin wan tzet jix el yunen tu'. Yin masanil tzet jix el yunen bey Judea yetoj bey conob Jerusalén, caw jix kila. Yet jix lawi wan tu' xin, jix t'unbale a naj yin culus yu eb ket Israelal. Quey tu' jix yute cam eb.
Pero ja' yet yox c'ual tu', jix pitzc'u a yu yipal Dios, catu' jix x'ox a sba e on.
Pero man masanil oj ánima bey jix x'ox a sba. Asanne e on jix x'ox a sba, yutol ja' tax peyxa, sic'bil jon el yu stestigoal oj. Catu' jix cu low yetoj yet jix pitzc'u a xol eb camnaj tu'.
Jix yal can e on, tol sowalil chi ec' kal el sk'aneal tet eb ánima, tzet utbil tol ja' Dios jix ak'on yopiso yu sna'on oc yin masanil ánima, eb iquis, c'al eb camnaj.
Ja' yet peyxa, yin ey oj to jix yalon can el sk'aneal Jesús eb ẍejab Dios. Yalnaj can jun jun eb, tol masanil c'al mac oj yaoc sc'ul yin, oj ak'le can lawoj spenail eb yu Jesús, ẍi naj Pedro tet eb.
Jix Ey Can Jul Santo Espíritu Yin Eb Man Israel Oj
Ja' yet lalan sk'anab naj Pedro tu', catu' jix eyol Santo Espíritu yiban masanil eb chi aben tzet chi yal naj.
Caw jix q'uey a sc'ul eb creyente Israel ey ec' yetoj Pedro tu', yutol jix yak' pax Santo Espíritu tet eb man Israel oj tu'.
Jix yab eb tol chi k'anab eb yin wan tx'oj ti'eal. Catu' jix yaben pax eb yalon watx' k'ane eb tet Dios.
Catu' jix yalon Pedro jaxca ti': —Jix ak'le Santo Espíritu tet eb jaxca jix yun yak'le e on. Yuxan, ¿tumi ey mac chi ske' yaloni, tol c'am chi ske' chi yak' bautizar sba eb? ẍi naj Pedro.
Yuxan jix yal naj Pedro tol chi ak'le bautizar eb yin sbi Jesucristo. Ja' yet jix yak'le bautizar eb tu', catu' jix sk'anon favor eb tet Pedro tol chi can jayeb oj c'u yetoj eb.

footnotes.text: Ja' wan na yet tiempo tu', panan ẍumuc eb. Ey bey chi atoj eb ánima xew yiban eb tu'.
Ey wan no' nok' ey oc yul sábana tu', c'am chi ske' ẍi'on eb Israel, yutol jaxca tu' yalon sley eb.
